name: WeaveGrid
description: rdloom's signature backdrop: warp and weft threads crossing in a woven grid, with an ember shuttle that passes through slowly.

warpColor.description: Colour of the vertical warp threads.

weftColor.description: Colour of the horizontal weft threads.

accent.description: Colour of the shuttle pass. Defaults to the ember token.

fade.description: Fades the weave out toward its edges.

isStill.description: Stops all movement. Moving content should be stoppable.

requirements: Pure decoration: aria-hidden, never focusable, and pointer-events none so content on top stays usable
Drawn with CSS only, so it needs no JavaScript and is safe in server HTML
The shuttle is a soft band that crosses slowly, never a flash
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), with isStill, and inside an rdm-still container
Nothing flashes more than 3 times a second (WCAG 2.3.1) and moving content can be stopped (WCAG 2.2.2)
Hidden in forced-colors (high contrast) mode so it never fights system colours
Keep text on top at 4.5:1 against the effect: use a low-contrast colour

use_when: Branded hero sections and empty states
A signature backdrop for rdloom-styled pages
anti_patterns: A strong thread colour that competes with content
Running more than one WeaveGrid in view
